newsitem.title: UK: London stocks open lower as market consolidates.
newsitem.headline: London stocks open lower as market consolidates.

text.p: UK shares headed lower on Wednesday as a mixed session on Wall Street Tuesday and weaker bond markets, encouraged some mild profit-taking.
The FTSE 100 index, which had risen 137 points or 3.2 percent while closing at record levels the previous six sessions, was down 14.7 points to 4,429.6 by 0845 GMT.
"A bit of profit-taking is too be expected. But I can't see any major sell-off today," one senior dealer said.
"After an initial mark-down the FTSE will probably just mess around in a tight range and wait for Wall Street." On Tuesday, the Dow closed 5.77 points up to a record level of 7,085.16.
